summary.text: Valerie Gaydos is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House District 44 who took office on December 1, 2018, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A small business owner and advocate, she is a 1989 graduate of Dickinson College.

paragraphs.text: Gaydos graduated from Dickinson College in 1989, and her career experience includes working as a small business owner and advocate.
Gaydos succeeded T. Mark Mustio in District 44.
In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Government Oversight Committee and the Liquor Control Committee, where she served as secretary.
Democrat Hadley Haas is her opponent on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
